basic_info.description: Perched on the sun-drenched southwest slope of iconic Bernal Hill, this impeccably reimagined modern residence is a rare fusion of architectural elegance and everyday livability. From the moment you enter, you're greeted by the warm richness of wide-plank natural oak floors, soaring ceilings, and a thoughtfully open layout that invites light, flow, and flexibility into every corner. Completely rebuilt down to the studs with exacting attention to detail, this 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom home delivers contemporary luxury without pretension. The heart of the home is a stunning kitchen and great room that seamlessly connects to the outdoors via a dramatic floor-to-ceiling movable glass wall perfect for alfresco dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying Bernal's famously sunny microclimate. Outfitted with top-tier Wolf appliances, Grohe fixtures, and refined finishes throughout, the home feels as effortless as it is exceptional. With designer bathrooms, all-new systems, and a coveted off-street parking space, this turn-key residence checks every box for modern city living. All this, and a gorgeous 1 bedroom apartment with its own laundry and garage!
